title: Introduce deterministic seeding and cohort-resampling CI hook for prompt regression
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: Add a new CI hook that enforces deterministic evaluation seeds and performs cohort-resampling when a prompt-set is unstable across runs. Motivation: We observed intermittent flakiness in prompt regression checks driven by non-deterministic sampling and small cohorts; teams were getting noisy failures for legitimate model changes. This PR introduces two complementary mechanisms: (1) deterministic seeding at the harness level with a reproducible RNG seed that is recorded per run, and (2) a cohort-resampling strategy that expands failing cohorts and re-evaluates to distinguish statistical noise from real regressions. Implementation: - New CI hook `eval-harness/ci/hooks/stable_cohort_check.py` that wraps existing eval jobs. The hook pins RNG seeds for sampling, logs seed metadata to the run artifact, and when a cohort fails the configured threshold, triggers an automated resample up to a configurable max-resamples (default 3x) with the same seed family to produce a confidence estimate. - A light-weight resampling scheduler that runs within the CI container; it calls into existing `eval-harness` entrypoints so no duplicate eval logic is added. - Integration with CI metadata: the hook annotates the GitHub Check with deterministic-seed:<seed> and a confidence score (pass/confident, pass/uncertain, fail/confident). - Config: repo-level YAML under `eval-harness/ci/configs/stable-cohort.yaml` with tunables: seed-entropy, max-resamples, cohort-size-multiplier, significance-threshold. Testing & CI: - Unit tests for seed propagation and resampling logic (tests/ci/test_stable_cohort.py). - Integration test that simulates flakey prompt responses via a mocked sampler and verifies the hook escalates only on consistent failures. - E2E in a staging runner that executed against a small suite of real prompt-sets; artifact logs include recorded seeds and resample traces. - CI matrix runs: python unit, integration, eval-smoke, lint. All checks passed after one re-run of flaky integration. Rollout & Next steps: - Default behavior is opt-in via repo config; we'll enable for core prompt-sets after two weeks of monitoring. - Follow-up PR to add a dashboard in Console showing seed heatmaps and resample confidence over time. Related: closes ENG-2119, links to PM-423 for rollout plan.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in CI hook that enforces deterministic seeds for eval runs and performs cohort-resampling to reduce false-positive prompt regressions. Configurable params: seed-entropy, max-resamples, cohort-size-multiplier. Notes: enabled by config; safe default keeps CI cost bounded.
